title: Internal HTTP API Reference
desc: The internal domain route groups behind the UI.
lede: The UI is backed by internal domain routes. These are grouped by area.
body:
At a glance
  • projects / chapters / voices / queue.
  • generation / jobs / settings / system.
  • analysis / migration / engines.

Route groups

  • Content — projects, chapters, voices.
  • Work — generation, jobs, queue.
  • System — settings, system, engines, analysis, migration.
Note — These are internal routes for the UI. For the external, documented surface see the TTS Gateway API.
